hub.rest.button: Auto-play the rest of the league ({n} games)
hub.rest.h: Play the rest of the league?
hub.rest.body: Plays your {n} remaining league games now, without watching, with your current lineup and saved Game Plan. Tired players are not rested. This cannot be undone.
hub.rest.done: Played {n} league games: {w} won, {l} lost. You are now in place {rank} of {clubs} in the table.
